description: v5 schema (2026-06-16): the Read is a labeled, ordered `sections` array (not a flat paragraph). Section labels come from the fixed set (The week / The hard days / The long run / How you felt / One thing). The long run is named through an inline WORKOUT REF that carries its own display `text` ({text, workout_id}); a niggle is a NIGGLE REF ({text, niggle}). The single soft question lives in its own `question` field, never inside a section. The goal backdrop is the `eyebrow` scope line. recorded_response is an authored target exemplar — re-record via _evals/record.ts before trusting as a baseline.
